claim: Patchline keeps a launch kit for star-growth that bundles the assets a public launch actually needs — a README hook, a long-form post, a short social thread, a demo script, and an FAQ — and validates them mechanically so the launch cannot go out with a missing channel or a social post that exceeds the platform character limit. The worker checks that every required channel is present and non-empty and that each social post respects its length budget, rejecting any post that runs over the limit. The gate proves a complete kit with an in-budget thread passes while an over-length social post is flagged and blocks the launch.
